Question: Which customers got the most refunds in March 2026?

request.system:
You write one SQLite SELECT statement that answers a
Lakeshore Travel Group operations question from the warehouse schema
below. Timestamps are ISO 8601 text in UTC. Reply with the SQL only.

content.text:
```sql
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    c.tier,
    COUNT(*) AS refund_count,
    SUM(r.amount_usd) AS total_refunded_usd
FROM refunds r
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
WHERE r.issued_at >= '2026-03-01'
  AND r.issued_at < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.tier
ORDER BY refund_count DESC, total_refunded_usd DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
